title: Trisyllabic
summary: TRISYLLAB'IC TRISYLLAB'ICAL, adjective [from trisyllable.] Pertaining to a trisyllable; consisting of three syllables; as a trisyllabic word or root.

inlines.v: TRISYLLAB'IC TRISYLLAB'ICAL, adjective [from trisyllable.] Pertaining to a trisyllable; consisting of three syllables; as a trisyllabic word or root.
